$ cursor-agent mcp --help
exit=0
Usage: agent mcp [options] [command]

Manage MCP servers

Options:
  -h, --help               Display help for command

Commands:
  login <identifier>       Authenticate with an MCP server configured in
                           .cursor/mcp.json or ~/.cursor/mcp.json
  list                     List configured MCP servers and their status
  list-tools <identifier>  List available tools and their argument names for a
                           specific MCP
  enable <identifier>      Add an MCP server to the local approved list
  disable <identifier>     Disable an MCP server (it will not be loaded or
                           prompted for approval)
